description: This file defines data structures, enums, and constants related to Sounding Reference Signal (SRS) configuration in 5G NR, including resource sets, resources, periodicity, and spatial relations, following 3GPP TS 38.331 specifications.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config
classes.description: Main structure for configuring SRS in NR, including resource sets, resources, positional resources, and related parameters.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_resource_set
classes.description: Defines a set of SRS resources with parameters like resource IDs, usage, power control, and timing.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_resource
classes.description: Represents an individual SRS resource with parameters such as ports, frequency hopping, spatial relation, and periodicity.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_pos_resource
classes.description: Defines positional SRS resources with parameters for OFDM symbol location, frequency position, and spatial relation.

methods.name: to_string(srs_resource_type res_type)
methods.description: Converts an srs_resource_type enum value to its string representation.
